features.title: Harness Bootstrap And Acceptance Scope Lock
features.goal: Create the dedicated rel0415 acceptance harness and lock the final validation definition.
acceptance: HarnessPlan/rel0415_acceptance contains the standard harness artifacts
The acceptance scope explicitly matches the user's 0415 criteria
The harness records git merge-back rules into release/0415 and master
result: Created a dedicated acceptance harness for the final 0415 validation round
Locked the new acceptance definition and git merge-back rules
features.commit_rule: Commit only acceptance harness bootstrap files.

features.title: Real Data Inventory And Path Verification
features.goal: Verify whether the recorded real-data paths are still readable and usable for this acceptance round.
acceptance: All recorded real-data paths are checked for existence and readability
Any broken path is replaced or explicitly blocked in the progress log
The harness notes exactly which data set will be used for acceptance
result: Revalidated the recorded reference text path /Volumes/XIAOMA-A-1T/wei_videodb/ref.txt
Confirmed the recorded real-data set is still available for the acceptance round
features.commit_rule: Commit only acceptance inventory notes and harness tracking.

features.title: Playwright Live Route Reachability
features.goal: Add and run Playwright checks that prove the live domain serves the 0415 routes.
acceptance: Playwright checks /welcome, /smart-cut, /tasks, /tts, and /admin/tasks
The checks are wired into the acceptance harness
Failures produce reproducible artifacts or logs
result: Added a dedicated rel0415 live-route Playwright suite
Executed the suite on A-machine against https://xiaomajianji.cn
Confirmed /welcome, /smart-cut, /tasks, /tts, and /admin/tasks all respond under the live domain
features.commit_rule: Commit only live-route Playwright coverage and acceptance harness updates.

features.title: Playwright Smart Cut End To End
features.goal: Automate the Smart Cut user path in Playwright as far as the current live auth and upload mechanics allow.
acceptance: Playwright covers login -> smart-cut entry -> task creation -> key user actions
The test captures evidence for state changes instead of only checking route existence
Known auth or upload blockers are recorded explicitly if full browser upload cannot be completed
features.commit_rule: Commit only Smart Cut Playwright coverage and acceptance tracking.

features.title: Real Data Analyze Acceptance
features.goal: Run the recorded real-data case through analyze and capture real evidence.
acceptance: A real-data task reaches analyze success or a grounded failure reason is captured
analyze outputs are recorded
The run is documented under acceptance reports
features.commit_rule: Commit only real-data analyze evidence and harness tracking.

features.title: Real Data Preview And Finalize Acceptance
features.goal: Run preview and finalize on the real-data task and capture the final output evidence.
acceptance: A real-data task reaches preview success
A real-data task reaches finalize success
Final output evidence is recorded
verification: capture final task detail and output keys
features.commit_rule: Commit only real-data preview/finalize evidence and harness tracking.

features.title: Task Center Status And Download Assertions
features.goal: Validate Task Center rendering, status mapping, and final download visibility against real task data.
acceptance: Task Center shows the accepted task with the expected status progression
Finished tasks expose download_url or equivalent final download evidence
The user and admin views are both checked
verification: capture task-center API payloads and screenshots
features.commit_rule: Commit only task-center acceptance assertions and harness tracking.

features.title: Queueing Scenario Verification
features.goal: Validate that more than one task can be observed in queued/running/waiting/finished states and that queue semantics are visible.
acceptance: At least two tasks are created close together
Queue-related visibility is captured in Task Center
The acceptance report explains what was observed for queue ordering/position
features.commit_rule: Commit only queue verification evidence and harness tracking.

features.title: Release Verdict And Merge Back Checklist
features.goal: Produce the final acceptance verdict and the git merge-back checklist into release/0415 and master.
acceptance: An acceptance verdict report exists under HarnessPlan/rel0415_acceptance/reports
All A01-A08 features are marked done before A09 passes
The harness explicitly records what should be pulled back into release/0415 and master
features.commit_rule: Commit only final verdict and merge-back guidance.
